question: Pourquoi ce joueur est-il l'homme du match ?
answer: Alfonso Espino earned Man of the Match honors with a perfect 10.0 rating, driven by a dominant defensive performance anchored by his top contributions in tackles (0.167) and won duels (0.15). His ability to intercept passes (0.08) and maintain passing accuracy (0.039) allowed Rayo Vallecano to control the midfield and secure the 2-0 victory, effectively neutralizing Almeria's attacks while providing stability at the back.
